ayahs.textArabic: الۤمّۤ
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: GOD - there is no deity save Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsistent Fount of All Being!

ayahs.textArabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَاَنْزَلَ التَّوْرٰىةَ وَالْاِنْجِيْلَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Nazzala ‘alaikal-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqal limā baina yadaihi wa anzalat-taurāta wal-injīl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Step by step has He bestowed upon thee from on high this divine writ, setting forth the truth which confirms whatever there still remains [of earlier revelations]: for it is He who has bestowed from on high the Torah and the Gospel

ayahs.textArabic: مِنْ قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَاَنْزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ ەۗ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ ۗوَاللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Min qablu hudal lin-nāsi wa anzalal-furqān(a), innal-lażīna kafarū bi āyātillāhi lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wallāhu ‘azīzun żuntiqām(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: aforetime, as a guidance unto mankind, and it is He who has bestowed [upon man] the standard by which to discern the true from the false. Behold, as for those who are bent on denying God's messages - grievous suffering awaits them: for God is almighty, an avenger of evil.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِى السَّمَاۤءِ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha lā yakhfā ‘alaihi syai'un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, nothing on earth or in the heavens is hidden from God.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ الَّذِيْ يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى الْاَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاۤءُ ۗ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Huwal-lażī yuṣawwirukum fil-arḥāmi kaifa yasyā'(u), lā ilāha illā huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no deity save Him, the Almighty, the Truly Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْهُ اٰيٰتٌ مُّحْكَمٰتٌ هُنَّ اُمُّ الْكِتٰبِ وَاُخَرُ مُتَشٰبِهٰتٌ ۗ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُوْنَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغَاۤءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغَاۤءَ تَأْوِيْلِهٖۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيْلَهٗٓ  اِلَّا اللّٰهُ  ۘوَالرّٰسِخُوْنَ فِى الْعِلْمِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۙ  كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّنَا ۚ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّآ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Huwal-lażī anzala ‘alaikal-kitāba minhu āyātum muḥkamātun hunna ummul-kitābi wa ukharu mutasyābihāt(un), fa'ammal-lażīna fī qulūbihim zaigun fayattabi‘ūna mā tasyābaha minhubtigā'al-fitnati wabtigā'a ta'wīlih(ī), wa mā ya‘lamu ta'wīlahū illallāh(u), war-rāsikhūna fil-‘ilmi yaqūlūna āmannā bih(ī), kullum min ‘indi rabbinā, wa mā yażżakkaru illā ulul-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who has bestowed upon thee from on high this divine writ, containing messages that are clear in and by themselves - and these are the essence of the divine writ - as well as others that are allegorical. Now those whose hearts are given to swerving from the truth go after that part of the divine writ which has been expressed in allegory, seeking out [what is bound to create] confusion, and seeking [to arrive at] its final meaning [in an arbitrary manner]; but none save God knows its final meaning. Hence, those who are deeply rooted in knowledge say: "We believe in it; the whole [of the divine writ] is from our Sustainer - albeit none takes this to heart save those who are endowed with insight.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚاِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā lā tuzig qulūbanā ba‘da iż hadaitanā wa hab lanā mil ladunka raḥmah(tan), innaka antal-wahhāb(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O our Sustainer! Let not our hearts swerve from the truth after Thou hast guided us; and bestow upon us the gift of Thy grace: verily, Thou art the [true] Giver of Gifts.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā innaka jāmi‘un-nāsi liyaumil lā raiba fīh(i), innallāha lā yukhliful-mī‘ād(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O our Sustainer! Verily, Thou wilt gather mankind together to witness the Day about [the coming of] which there is no doubt: verily, God never fails to fulfil His promise."

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَادُهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْـًٔا ۗوَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمْ وَقُوْدُ النَّارِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna kafarū lan tugniya ‘anhum amwāluhum wa lā aulāduhum minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa ulā'ika hum waqūdun-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, as for those who are bent on denying the truth - neither their worldly possessions nor their offspring will in the least avail them against God; and it is they, they who shall be the fuel of the fire!

ayahs.textArabic: كَدَأْبِ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَۙ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْۗ  كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۚ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ شَدِيْدُ الْعِقَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Kada'bi āli fir‘aun(a), wal-lażīna min qablihim, każżabū bi'āyātinā, fa'akhażahumullāhu biżunūbihim, wallāhu syadīdul-‘iqāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [To them shall - happen] the like of what happened to Pharaoh's people and those who lived before them: they gave the lie to Our messages - and so God took them to task for their sins: for God is severe in retribution.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا سَتُغْلَبُوْنَ وَتُحْشَرُوْنَ اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ ۗ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul lil-lażīna kafarū satuglabūna wa tuḥsyarūna ilā jahannam(a), wa bi'sal-mihād(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say unto those who are bent on denying the truth: "You shall be overcome and gathered unto hell - and how evil a resting-place!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ اٰيَةٌ فِيْ فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَا ۗفِئَةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَاُخْرٰى كَافِرَةٌ يَّرَوْنَهُمْ مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْيَ الْعَيْنِ ۗوَاللّٰهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ ۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّاُولِى الْاَبْصَارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad kāna lakum āyatun fī fi'atainil taqatā, fi'atun tuqātilu fī sabīlillāhi wa ukhrā kāfiratuy yaraunahum miṡlaihim ra'yal-‘ain(i), wallāhu yu'ayyidu binaṣrihī may yasyā'(u), inna fī żālika la‘ibratal li'ulil-abṣār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: You have already had a sign in the two hosts that met in battle, one host fighting in God's cause and the other denying Him; with their own eyes [the former] saw the others as twice their own number: but God strengthens with His succour whom He wills. In this, behold, there is indeed a lesson for all who have eyes to see.

ayahs.textArabic: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوٰتِ مِنَ النِّسَاۤءِ وَالْبَنِيْنَ وَالْقَنَاطِيْرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِ ۗ ذٰلِكَ مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۗوَاللّٰهُ عِنْدَهٗ حُسْنُ الْمَاٰبِ
ayahs.textLatin: Zuyyina lin-nāsi ḥubbusy-syahawāti minan-nisā'i wal-banīna wal-qanāṭīril-muqanṭarati minaż-żahabi wal-fiḍḍati wal-khailil-musawwamati wal-an‘āmi wal-ḥarṡ(i), żālika matā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wallāhu ‘indahū ḥusnul-ma'āb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: ALLURING unto man is the enjoyment of worldly desires through women, and children, and heaped-up treasures of gold and silver, and horses of high mark, and cattle, and lands. All this may be enjoyed in the life of this world - but the most beauteous of all goals is with God.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قُلْ اَؤُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْ ذٰلِكُمْ ۗ لِلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَاَزْوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّرِضْوَانٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul a'unabbi'ukum bikhairim min żālikum, lil-lażīnattaqau ‘inda rabbihim jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wa azwājum muṭahharatuw wa riḍwānum minallāh(i), wallāhu baṣīrum bil-‘ibād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Shall I tell you of better things than those [earthly joys]? For the God-conscious there are, with their Sustainer, gardens through which running waters flow, therein to abide, and spouses pure, and God's goodly acceptance." And God sees all that is in [the hearts of] His servants -

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَآ اِنَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yaqūlūna rabbanā innanā āmannā fagfir lanā żunūbanā wa qinā ‘ażāban-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: those who say, "O our Sustainer! Behold, we believe [in Thee]; forgive us, then, our sins, and keep us safe from suffering through the fire" -:

ayahs.textArabic: اَلصّٰبِرِيْنَ وَالصّٰدِقِيْنَ وَالْقٰنِتِيْنَ وَالْمُنْفِقِيْنَ وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ بِالْاَسْحَارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Aṣ-ṣābirīna waṣ-ṣādiqīna wal-qāniṭīna wal-munfiqīna wal-mustagfirīna bil-asḥār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: those who are patient in adversity, and true to their word, and truly devout, and who spend [in God's way], and pray for forgiveness from their innermost hearts.

ayahs.textArabic: شَهِدَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّهٗ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۙ وَالْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ وَاُولُوا الْعِلْمِ قَاۤىِٕمًاۢ بِالْقِسْطِۗ  لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Syahidallāhu annahū lā ilāha illā huw(a), wal-malā'ikatu wa ulul-‘ilmi qā'imam bil-qisṭ(i), lā ilāha illā huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: GOD [Himself] proffers evidence - and [so do] the angels and all who are endowed with knowledge - that there is no deity save Him, the Upholder of Equity: there is no deity save Him, the Almighty, the Truly Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الدِّيْنَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الْاِسْلَامُ ۗ وَمَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗوَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Innad-dīna ‘indallāhil-islām(u), wa makhtalafal-lażīna ūtul-kitāba illā mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-‘ilmu bagyam bainahum, wa may yakfur bi'āyātillāhi fa innallāha sarī‘ul-ḥisāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, the only [true] religion in the sight of God is [man's] self-surrender unto Him; and those who were vouchsafed revelation aforetime took, out of mutual jealousy, to divergent views [on this point] only after knowledge [thereof] had come unto them. But as for him who denies the truth of God's messages - behold, God is swift in reckoning!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ حَاۤجُّوْكَ فَقُلْ اَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلّٰهِ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِ ۗوَقُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ وَالْاُمِّيّٖنَ ءَاَسْلَمْتُمْ ۗ فَاِنْ اَسْلَمُوْا فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوْا ۚ وَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلٰغُ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'in ḥājjūka fa qul aslamtu wajhiya lillāhi wa manittaba‘an(i), wa qul lil-lażīna ūtul-kitāba wal-ummiyyīna a'aslamtum, fa'in aslamū faqadihtadau, wa in tawallau fa'innamā ‘alaikal-balāg(u), wallāhu baṣīrum bil-‘ibād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, [O Prophet,] if they argue with thee, say, "I have surrendered my whole being unto God, and [so have] all who follow me!" - and ask those who have been vouchsafed revelation aforetime, as well as all unlettered people, "Have you [too] surrendered yourselves unto Him?" And if they surrender themselves unto Him, they are on the right path; but if they turn away - behold, thy duty is no more than to deliver the message: for God sees all that is in [the hearts of] His creatures.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ بِغَيْرِحَقٍّۖ وَّيَقْتُلُوْنَ الَّذِيْنَ يَأْمُرُوْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِۙ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna yakfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa yaqtulūnan nabiyyīna bigairi ḥaqq(in), wa yaqtulūnal-lażīna ya'murūna bil-qisṭi minan-nās(i), fabasysyirhum bi‘ażābin alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, as for those who deny the truth of God's messages, and slay the prophets against all right, and slay people who enjoin equity - announce unto them a grievous chastisement.

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ حَبِطَتْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ ۖ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ikal-lażīna ḥabiṭat a‘māluhum fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is they whose works shall come to nought both in this world and in the life to come; and they shall have none to succour them.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوْا نَصِيْبًا مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ اِلٰى كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّٰى فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara ilal-lażīna ūtū naṣībam minal-kitābi yud‘auna ilā kitābillāhi liyaḥkuma bainahum ṡumma yatawallā farīqum minhum wa hum mu‘riḍūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Art thou not aware of those who have been granted their share of revelation [aforetime]? They have been called upon to let God's writ be their law - and yet some of them turn away [from it] in their obstinacy,

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّآ اَيَّامًا مَّعْدُوْدٰتٍ ۖ وَّغَرَّهُمْ فِيْ دِيْنِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika bi'annahum qālū lan tamassanan nāru illā ayyāmam ma‘dūdāt(in), wa garrahum fī dīnihim mā kānū yaftarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: simply because they claim, "The fire will most certainly not touch us for more than a limited number of days": and thus the false beliefs which they invented have [in time] caused them to betray their faith.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيْفَ اِذَا جَمَعْنٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِۗ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fakaifa iżā jama‘nāhum liyaumil lā raiba fīh(i), wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim mā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: How, then, [will they fare] when We shall gather them all together to witness the Day about [the coming of] which there is no doubt, and every human being shall be repaid in full for what he has done, and none shall be wronged?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاۤءُۖ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ ۗ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ ۗ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qulillāhumma mālikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tasyā'u wa tanzi‘ul-mulka mim man tasyā'(u), wa tu‘izzu man tasyā'u wa tużillu man tasyā'(u), biyadikal-khair(u), innaka ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: "O God, Lord of all dominion! Thou grantest dominion unto whom Thou willest, and takest away dominion from whom Thou willest; and Thou exaltest whom Thou willest, and abasest whom Thou willest. In Thy hand is all good. Verily, Thou hast the power to will anything.

ayahs.textArabic: تُوْلِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَتُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Tūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa tūlijun-nahāra fil-laili wa tukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-ḥayyi wa tarzuqu man tasyā'u bigairi ḥisāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: "Thou makest the night grow longer by shortening the day, and Thou makest the day grow longer by shortening the night. And Thou bringest forth the living out of that which is dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead out of that which is alive. And Thou grantest sustenance unto whom `Thou willest, beyond all reckoning."

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ مِنْ دُوْنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ فِيْ شَيْءٍ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَتَّقُوْا مِنْهُمْ تُقٰىةً ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهٗ ۗ وَاِلَى اللّٰهِ الْمَصِيْرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yattakhiżil-mu'minūnal-kāfirīna auliyā'a min dūnil-mu'minīn(a), wa may yaf‘al żālika falaisa minallāhi fī syai'(in), illā an tattaqū minhum tuqāh(tan), wa yuḥażżirukumullāhu nafsah(ū), wa ilallāhil-maṣīr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: LET NOT the believers take those who deny the truth for their allies in preference to the believers - since he who does this cuts himself off from God in everything - unless it be to protect yourselves against them in this way. But God warns you to beware of Him: for with God is all journeys' end.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنْ تُخْفُوْا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ اَوْ تُبْدُوْهُ يَعْلَمْهُ اللّٰهُ ۗوَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِۗ وَاللّٰهُ  عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul in tukhfū mā fī ṣudūrikum  au tubdūhu ya‘lamhullāh(u), wa ya‘lamu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wallāhu ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Whether you conceal what is in your hearts or bring it into the open, God knows it: for He knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; and God has the power to will anything."

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا  ۛوَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ سُوْۤءٍ ۛ تَوَدُّ لَوْ اَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهٗٓ اَمَدًاۢ بَعِيْدًا ۗوَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفْسَهٗ ۗوَاللّٰهُ رَءُوْفٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim mā ‘amilat min khairim muḥḍarā(n), wa mā ‘amilat min sū'(in), tawaddu lau anna bainahā wa bainahū amadam ba‘īdā(n), wa yuḥażżirukumullāhu nafsah(ū), wallāhu ra'ūfum bil-‘ibād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: On the Day when every human being will find himself faced with all the good that he has done, and with all the evil that he has done, [many a one] will wish that there were a long span of time between himself and that [Day]. Hence, God warns you to beware of Him; but God is most compassionate towards His creatures.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّوْنَ اللّٰهَ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِيْ يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul in kuntum tuḥibbūnallāha fattabi‘ūnī yuḥbibkumullāhu wa yagfir lakum żunūbakum, wallāhu gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say [O Prophet]: "If you love God, follow me, [and] God will love you and forgive you your sins; for God is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace."

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوْلَ ۚ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul aṭī‘ullāha war-rasūl(a), fa'in tawallau fa innallāha lā yuḥibbul-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Pay heed unto God and the Apostle.” And if they turn away - verely, God does not love those who deny the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰىٓ اٰدَمَ وَنُوْحًا وَّاٰلَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاٰلَ عِمْرٰنَ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāhaṣṭafā ādama wa nūḥaw wa āla ibrāhīma wa āla ‘imrāna ‘alal-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, God raised Adam, and Noah, and the House of Abraham, and the House of `Imran above all mankind,

ayahs.textArabic: ذُرِّيَّةً ۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنْۢ بَعْضٍۗ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Żurriyyatam ba‘ḍuhā mim ba‘ḍ(in), wallāhu samī‘un ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: in one line of descent. And God was all-hearing, all-knowing

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ عِمْرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِيْ بَطْنِيْ مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّيْ ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qālatimra'atu ‘imrāna rabbi innī nażartu laka mā fī baṭnī muḥarraran fataqabbal minnī, innaka antas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: when a woman of [the House of] `Imran prayed: "O my Sustainer! Behold, unto Thee do I vow [the child] that is in, my womb, to be devoted to Thy service. Accept it, then, from me: verily, Thou alone art all-hearing, all-knowing!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ وَضَعْتُهَآ اُنْثٰىۗ وَاللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْۗ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْاُنْثٰى ۚ وَاِنِّيْ سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَاِنِّيْٓ اُعِيْذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ الرَّجِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā waḍa‘athā qālat rabbi innī waḍa‘tuhā unṡā, wallāhu a‘lamu bimā waḍa‘at, wa laisaż-żakaru kal-unṡā, wa innī sammaituhā maryama wa innī u‘īżuhā bika wa żurriyyatahā minasy-syaiṭānir-rajīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: But when she had given birth to the child, she said: "O my Sustainer! Behold, I have given birth to a female" - the while God had been fully aware of what she would give birth to, and [fully aware] that no male child [she might have hoped for] could ever have been like this female - "and I have named her Mary. And, verily, I seek Thy protection for her and her offspring against Satan, the accursed."

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُوْلٍ حَسَنٍ وَّاَنْۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًاۖ وَّكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۗ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَۙ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًا ۚ قَالَ يٰمَرْيَمُ اَنّٰى لَكِ هٰذَا ۗ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fataqabbalahā rabbuhā biqabūlin ḥasaniw wa ambatahā nabātan ḥasanā(n), wa kaffalahā zakariyyā, kullamā dakhala ‘alaihā zakariyyal-miḥrāba wajada ‘indahā rizqā(n), qāla yā maryama annā laki hāżā, qālat huwa min ‘indillāh(i), innallāha yarzuqu may yasyā'u bigairi ḥisāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thereupon her Sustainer accepted the girl-child with goodly acceptance, and caused her to grow up in goodly growth, and placed her in the care of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah visited her in the sanctuary, he found her provided with food. He would ask: "O Mary, whence came this unto thee?" She would answer: "It is from God; behold, God grants sustenance unto whom He wills, beyond all reckoning."

ayahs.textArabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهٗ ۚ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۚ اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاۤءِ
ayahs.textLatin: Hunālika da‘ā zakariyyā rabbahū qāla rabbi hab lī mil ladunka żurriyyatan ṭayyibah(tan), innaka samī‘ud-du‘ā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: In that self-same place, Zachariah prayed unto his Sustainer, saying: "O my Sustainer! Bestow upon me [too], out of Thy grace, the gift of goodly offspring; for Thou, indeed, hearest all prayer."

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ وَهُوَ قَاۤىِٕمٌ يُّصَلِّيْ فِى الْمِحْرَابِۙ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيٰى مُصَدِّقًاۢ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَّحَصُوْرًا وَّنَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fanādathul-malā'ikatu wa huwa qā'imuy yuṣallī fil-miḥrāb(i), annallāha yubasysyiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqam bikalimatim minallāhi wa sayyidaw wa ḥaṣūraw wa nabiyyam minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon, as he stood praying in the sanctuary, the angels called out unto him: "God sends thee the glad tiding of [the birth of] John, who shall confirm the truth of a word from God, and [shall be] outstanding among men, and utterly chaste, and a prophet from among the righteous."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُوْنُ لِيْ غُلٰمٌ وَّقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ وَامْرَاَتِيْ عَاقِرٌ ۗ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللّٰهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاۤءُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa qad balaganīyal-kibaru wamra'atī ‘āqir(un), qāla każālikallāhu yaf‘alu mā yasyā'(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Zachariah] exclaimed: "O my Sustainer! How can I have a son when old age has already overtaken me, and my wife is barren?" Answered [the angel]: "Thus it is: God does what He wills."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِّيْٓ اٰيَةً ۗ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍ اِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ وَاذْكُرْ رَّبَّكَ كَثِيْرًا وَّسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْاِبْكَارِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbij‘al lī āyah(tan), qāla āyatuka allā tukalliman-nāsa  ṡalāṡata ayyāmin illā ramzā(n), ważkur rabbaka kaṡīraw wa sabbiḥ bil-‘asyiyyi wal-ibkār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Zachariah] prayed: "O my Sustainer! Appoint a sign for me!" Said [the angel]: "Thy sign shall be that for three days thou wilt not speak unto men other than by gestures. And remember thy Sustainer unceasingly, and extol His limitless glory by night and by day."

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصْطَفٰىكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفٰىكِ عَلٰى نِسَاۤءِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qālatil-malā'ikatu yā maryama innallāhaṣṭafāki wa ṭahharaki waṣṭafāki ‘alā nisā'il-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND LO! The angels said: "O Mary! Behold, God has elected thee and made thee pure, and raised thee above all the women of the world.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰمَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِيْ لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِيْ وَارْكَعِيْ مَعَ الرّٰكِعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā maryamuqnutī lirabbiki wasjudī warka‘ī ma‘ar-rāki‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O Mary! Remain thou truly devout unto thy Sustainer, and prostrate thyself in worship, and bow down with those who bow down [before Him]."

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَاۤءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوْحِيْهِ اِلَيْكَ ۗوَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يُلْقُوْنَ اَقْلَامَهُمْ اَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَۖ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika min ambā'il-gaibi nūḥīhi ilaik(a), wa mā kunta ladaihim iż yulqūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryam(a), wa mā kunta ladaihim iż yakhtaṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: This account of something that was beyond the reach of thy perception We [now] reveal unto thee: for thou wert not with them when they drew lots as to which of them should be Mary's guardian, and thou wert not with them when they contended [about it] with one another.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ يٰمَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُۖ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيْحُ عِيْسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيْهًا فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qālatil-malā'ikatu yā maryama innallāha yubasysyiruki bikalimatim minhusmuhul-masīḥu ‘īsabnu maryama wajīhan fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirati wa minal-muqarrabīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! The angels said: "O Mary! Behold, God sends thee the glad tiding, through a word from Him, [of a son] who shall become known as the Christ Jesus, son of Mary, of great honour in this world and in the life to come, and [shall be] of those who are drawn near unto God.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِى الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَّمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yukallimun nāsa fil-mahdi wa kahlaw wa minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he shall speak unto men in his cradle, and as a grown man, and shall be of the righteous."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُوْنُ لِيْ وَلَدٌ وَّلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِيْ بَشَرٌ ۗ قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ اللّٰهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاۤءُ ۗاِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladuw wa lam yamsasnī basyar(un), qāla każālikillāhu yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), iżā qaḍā amran fa'innamā yaqūlu lahū kun fayakūn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said she: "O my Sustainer! How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me?" [The angel] answered: "Thus it is: God creates what He wills when He wills a thing to be, He but says unto it, 'Be' - and it is.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرٰىةَ وَالْاِنْجِيْلَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ya‘allimuhul-kitāba wal-ḥikmata wat-taurāta wal-injīl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he will impart unto thy son revelation, and wisdom, and the Torah, and the Gospel,

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَسُوْلًا اِلٰى بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ەۙ اَنِّيْ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ ۙاَنِّيْٓ اَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الطِّيْنِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ الطَّيْرِ فَاَنْفُخُ فِيْهِ فَيَكُوْنُ طَيْرًاۢ بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۚوَاُبْرِئُ الْاَكْمَهَ وَالْاَبْرَصَ وَاُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰى بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۚوَاُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُوْنَ ۙفِيْ بُيُوْتِكُمْ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa rasūlan ilā banī isrā'īl(a), annī qad ji'tukum bi'āyatim mir rabbikum, annī akhluqu lakum minaṭ-ṭīni kahai'atiṭ-ṭairi fa'anfukhu  fihi fayakūnu ṭairam bi'iżnillāh(i), wa ubarri'ul-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa uḥyil-mautā bi'iżnillāh(i), wa unabbi'ukum bimā ta'kulūna wa mā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum, inna fī żālika la'āyatal lakum in kuntum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [will make him] an apostle unto the children of Israel.” "I HAVE COME unto you with a message from your Sustainer. I shall create for you out of clay, as it were, the shape of [your] destiny, and then breathe into it, so that it might become [your] destiny by God's leave; and I shall heal the blind and the leper, and bring the dead back to life by God's leave; and I shall let you know what you may eat and what you should store up in your houses. Behold, in all this there is indeed a message for you, if you are [truly] believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرٰىةِ وَلِاُحِلَّ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِيْ حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ  وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْۗ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa muṣaddiqal limā baina yadayya minat-taurāti wa li'uḥilla lakum ba‘ḍal-lażī ḥurrima ‘alaikum wa ji'tukum bi'āyatim mir rabbikum, fattaqullāha wa aṭī‘ūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And [I have come] to confirm the truth of whatever there still remains of the Torah, and to make lawful unto you some of the things which [aforetime] were forbidden to you. And I have come unto you with a message from your Sustainer; remain, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ ۗهٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha rabbī wa rabbukum fa‘budūh(u), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: "Verily, God is my Sustainer as well as your Sustainer; so worship Him [alone]: this is a straight way."

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَلَمَّآ اَحَسَّ عِيْسٰى مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ اَنْصَارِيْٓ اِلَى اللّٰهِ ۗ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّوْنَ نَحْنُ اَنْصَارُ اللّٰهِ ۚ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ ۚ وَاشْهَدْ بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā aḥassa ‘īsā minhumul-kufra qāla man anṣārī ilallāh(i), qālal-ḥawāriyyūna naḥnu anṣārullāh(i), āmannā billāh(i), wasyhad bi'annā muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when Jesus became aware of their refusal to acknowledge the truth, he asked: "Who will be my helpers in God's cause?" The white-garbed ones replied: "We shall be [thy] helpers [in the cause] of God! We believe in God: and bear thou witness that we have surrendered ourselves unto Him!

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا بِمَآ اَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattaba‘nar-rasūla faktubnā ma‘asy-syāhidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O our Sustainer! We believe in what Thou hast bestowed from on high, and we follow this Apostle; make us one, then, with all who bear witness [to the truth]!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَكَرُوْا وَمَكَرَ اللّٰهُ  ۗوَاللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa makarū wa makarallāh(u), wallāhu khairul-mākirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the unbelievers schemed [against Jesus]; but God brought their scheming to nought: for God is above all schemers.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيْسٰٓى اِنِّيْ مُتَوَفِّيْكَ وَرَافِعُكَ اِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْكَ فَوْقَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ ۚ ثُمَّ اِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيْمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qālallāhu yā ‘īsā innī mutawaffīka wa rāfi‘uka ilayya wa muṭahhiruka minal-lażīna kafarū wa jā‘ilul-lażīnattaba‘ūka fauqal-lażīna kafarū ilā yaumil-qiyāmah(ti), ṡumma ilayya marji‘ukum fa aḥkumu bainakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! God said: "O Jesus! Verily, I shall cause thee to die, and shall exalt thee unto Me, and cleanse thee of [the presence of] those who are bent on denying the truth; and I shall place those who follow thee [far] above those who are bent on denying the truth, unto the Day of Resurrection. In the end, unto Me you all must return, and I shall judge between you with regard to all on which you were wont to differ.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَاُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِۖ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ammal-lażīna kafarū fa u‘ażżibuhum ‘ażāban syadīdan fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And as for those who are bent on denying the truth, I shall cause them to suffer a suffering severe in this world and in the life to come, and they shall have none to succour them;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيْهِمْ اُجُوْرَهُمْ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa yuwaffīhim ujūrahum, wallāhu lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas unto those who attain to faith and do good works He will grant their reward in full: for God does not love evildoers."

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ نَتْلُوْهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الْاٰيٰتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika natlūhu ‘alaika minal-āyāti waż-żikril-ḥakīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: THIS MESSAGE do We convey unto thee, and this tiding full of wisdom:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيْسٰى عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَ ۗ خَلَقَهٗ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna maṡala ‘īsā ‘indallāhi kamaṡali ādam(a), khalaqahū min turābin ṡumma qāla lahū kun fayakūn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, in the sight of God, the nature of Jesus is as the nature of Adam, whom He created out of dust and then said unto him, "Be" - and he is.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْمُمْتَرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-ḥaqqu mir rabbika falā takum minal-mumtarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [This is] the truth from thy Sustainer; be not, then, among the doubters!

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنْ حَاۤجَّكَ فِيْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۤءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ اَبْنَاۤءَنَا وَاَبْنَاۤءَكُمْ وَنِسَاۤءَنَا وَنِسَاۤءَكُمْ وَاَنْفُسَنَا وَاَنْفُسَكُمْۗ  ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَّعْنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْكٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faman ḥājjaka fīhi mim ba‘di mā jā'aka minal-‘ilmi faqul ta‘ālau nad‘u abnā'anā wa abnā'akum wa nisā'anā wa nisā'akum wa anfusanā wa anfusakum, ṡumma nabtahil fanaj‘al la‘natallāhi ‘alal-kāżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And if anyone should argue with thee about this [truth] after all the knowledge that has come unto thee, say: "Come! Let us summon our sons and your sons, and our women and your women, and ourselves and yourselves; and then let us pray [together] humbly and ardently, and let us invoke God's curse upon those [of us] who are telling a lie."

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ ۚ وَمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۗوَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżā lahuwal-qaṣaṣul-ḥaqq(u), wa mā min ilāhin illallāh(u), wa innallāha lahuwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, this is indeed the truth of the matter, and there is no deity whatever save God; and, verily, God - He alone - is almighty, truly wise.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ ۢبِالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa in tawallau fa innallāha ‘alīmum bil-mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And if they turn away [from this truth] - behold, God has full knowledge of the spreaders of corruption.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ تَعَالَوْا اِلٰى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاۤءٍۢ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ اَلَّا نَعْبُدَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهٖ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا اَرْبَابًا مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُوْلُوا اشْهَدُوْا بِاَنَّا مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi ta‘ālau ilā kalimatin sawā'im bainanā wa bainakum allā na‘buda illallāha wa lā nusyrika bihī syai'aw wa lā yattakhiża ba‘ḍunā ba‘ḍan arbābam min dūnillāh(i), fa in tawallau fa qūlusyhadū bi'annā muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "O followers of earlier revelation! Come unto that tenet which we and you hold in common: that we shall worship none but God, and that we shall not ascribe divinity to aught beside Him, and that we shall not take human beings for our lords beside God." And if they turn away, then say: "Bear witness that it is we who have surrendered ourselves unto Him."

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تُحَاۤجُّوْنَ فِيْٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْرٰىةُ وَالْاِنْجِيْلُ اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖۗ  اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ibrāhīma wa mā unzilatit-taurātu wal-injīlu illā mim ba‘dih(ī), afalā ta‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O FOLLOWERS of earlier revelation! Why do you argue about Abraham, seeing that the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed till [long] after him? Will you not, then, use your reason?

ayahs.textArabic: هٰٓاَنْتُمْ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيْمَا لَكُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَاۤجُّوْنَ فِيْمَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hā antum hā'ulā'i ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihī ‘ilmun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laisa lakum bihī ‘ilm(un), wallāhu ya‘lamu wa antum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! You are the ones who would argue about that which is known to you; but why do you argue about something which is unknown to you? Yet God knows [it], whereas you do not know:

ayahs.textArabic: مَاكَانَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ يَهُوْدِيًّا وَّلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَّلٰكِنْ كَانَ حَنِيْفًا مُّسْلِمًاۗ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā kāna ibrāhīmu yahūdiyyaw wa lā naṣrāniyyaw wa lākin kāna ḥanīfam muslimā(n), wa mā kāna minal-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Abraham was neither a "Jew" nor a "Christian", but was one who turned away from all that is false, having surrendered himself unto God; and he was not of those who ascribe divinity to aught beside Him.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِاِبْرٰهِيْمَ لَلَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْهُ وَهٰذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا ۗ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna aulan-nāsi bi'ibrāhīma lal-lażīnattaba‘ūhu wa hāżan-nabiyyu wal-lażīna āmanū, wallāhu waliyyul-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, the people who have the best claim to Abraham are surely those who follow him - as does this Prophet and all who believe [in him] - and God is near unto the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَدَّتْ طَّاۤىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّوْنَكُمْۗ وَمَا يُضِلُّوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Waddaṭ-ṭā'ifatum min ahlil-kitābi lau yuḍillūnakum, wa mā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wa mā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Some of the followers of earlier revelation would love to lead you astray: yet none do they lead astray but themselves, and perceive it not.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa antum tasyhadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O followers of earlier revelation! Why do you deny the truth of God's messages to which you yourselves bear witness?

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُوْنَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوْنَ الْحَقَّ وَاَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima talbisūnal-ḥaqqa bil-bāṭili wa taktumūnal-ḥaqqa wa antum ta‘lamūn.
ayahs.textEnglish: O followers of earlier revelation! Why do you cloak the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth of which you are [so well] aware?

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَتْ طَّاۤىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اٰمِنُوْا بِالَّذِيْٓ اُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوْٓا اٰخِرَهٗ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālaṭ-ṭā'ifatum min ahlil-kitābi āminū bil-lażī unzila ‘alal-lażīna āmanū wajhan-nahāri wakfurū ākhirahū la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And some of the followers of earlier revelation say [to one another]: "Declare your belief in what has been revealed unto those who believe [in Muhammad] at the beginning of the day, and deny the truth of what came later, so that they might go back [on their faith];

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوْٓا اِلَّا لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِيْنَكُمْ ۗ قُلْ اِنَّ الْهُدٰى هُدَى اللّٰهِ ۙ اَنْ يُّؤْتٰىٓ اَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ اُوْتِيْتُمْ اَوْ يُحَاۤجُّوْكُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ ۗ قُلْ اِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللّٰهِ ۚ يُؤْتِيْهِ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ  ۗوَاللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tu'minū illā liman tabi‘a dīnakum, qul innal-hudā hudallāh(i), ay yu'tā aḥadum miṡla mā ūtītum au yuḥājjūkum ‘inda rabbikum, qul innal-faḍla biyadillāh(i), yu'tīhi may yasyā'(u), wallāhu wāsi‘un ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: but do not [really] believe anyone who does not follow your own faith." Say: "Behold, all [true] guidance is God's guidance, consisting in one's being granted [revelation] such as you have been granted." Or would they contend against you before your Sustainer? Say: "Behold, all bounty is in the hand of God; He grants it unto whom He wills: for God is infinite, all-knowing,

ayahs.textArabic: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ  ۗوَاللّٰهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihī may yasyā'(u), wallāhu żul-faḍlil-‘aẓīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: singling out for His grace whom He wills. And God is limitless in His great bounty."

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ مَنْ اِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنْطَارٍ يُّؤَدِّهٖٓ اِلَيْكَۚ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِيْنَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهٖٓ اِلَيْكَ اِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَاۤىِٕمًا ۗ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى الْاُمِّيّٖنَ سَبِيْلٌۚ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min ahlil-kitābi man in ta'manhu bi qinṭārin yu'addīhi ilaik(a), wa minhum man in ta'manhu bidīnāril lā yu'addīhi ilaika illā mā dumta ‘alaihi qā'imā(n), żālika bi'annahum qālū laisa ‘alainā fil-ummiyyīna sabīl(un), wa yaqūlūna ‘alallāhil-każiba wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND AMONG the followers of earlier revelation there is many a one who, if thou entrust him with a treasure, will [faithfully] restore it to thee; and there is among them many a one who, if thou entrust him with a tiny gold coin, will not restore it to thee unless thou keep standing over him - which is an outcome of their assertion, "No blame can attach to us [for anything that we may do] with regard to these unlettered folk": and [so] they tell a lie about God, being well aware [that it is a lie]."

ayahs.textArabic: بَلٰى مَنْ اَوْفٰى بِعَهْدِهٖ وَاتَّقٰى فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Balā man aufā bi‘ahdihī wattaqā fa innallāha yuḥibbul-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but [God is aware of] those who keep their bond with Him, and are conscious of Him: and, verily, God loves those who are conscious of Him.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَشْتَرُوْنَ بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ وَاَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًا اُولٰۤىِٕكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلَا يَنْظُرُ اِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيْهِمْ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna yasytarūna bi‘ahdillāhi wa aimānihim ṡamanan qalīlan ulā'ika lā khalāqa lahum fil-ākhirati wa lā yukallimuhumullāhu wa lā yanẓuru ilaihim yaumal-qiyāmati wa lā yuzakkīhim, wa lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, those who barter away their bond with God and their own pledges for a trifling gain - they shall not partake in the blessings of the life to come; and God will neither speak unto them nor look upon them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He cleanse them of their sins; and grievous suffering awaits them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيْقًا يَّلْوٗنَ اَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالْكِتٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوْهُ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِۚ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ ۚ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna minhum lafarīqay yalwūna alsinatahum bil-kitābi litaḥsabūhu minal-kitābi wa mā huwa minal-kitāb(i), wa yaqūlūna huwa min ‘indillāhi wa mā huwa min ‘indillāh(i), wa yaqūlūna ‘alallāhil-każiba wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, behold, there are indeed some among them who distort the Bible with their tongues, so as to make you think that [what they say] is from the Bible, the while it is not from the Bible; and who say, "This is from God," the while it is not from God: and thus do they tell a lie about God, being well aware [that it is a lie].

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنْ يُّؤْتِيَهُ اللّٰهُ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُوْلَ لِلنَّاسِ كُوْنُوْا عِبَادًا لِّيْ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنْ كُوْنُوْا رَبَّانِيّٖنَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تُعَلِّمُوْنَ الْكِتٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَدْرُسُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā kāna libasyarin ay yu'tiyahullāhul-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwata ṡumma yaqūla lin-nāsi kūnū ‘ibādal lī min dūnillāhi wa lākin kūnū rabbāniyyīna bimā kuntum tu‘allimūnal-kitāba  wa bimā kuntum tadrusūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is not conceivable that a human being unto whom God had granted revelation, and sound judgment, and prophethood, should thereafter have said unto people, "Worship me beside God"; but rather [did he exhort them], "Become men of God by spreading the knowledge of the divine writ, and by your own deep study [thereof]."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ اَنْ تَتَّخِذُوا الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةَ وَالنَّبِيّٖنَ اَرْبَابًا ۗ اَيَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā ya'murakum an tattakhiżul-malā'ikata wan-nabiyyīna arbābā(n), aya'murukum bil-kufri ba‘da iż antum muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And neither did he bid you to take the angels and the prophets for your lords: [for] would he bid you to deny the truth after you have surrendered yourselves unto God?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاقَ النَّبِيّٖنَ لَمَآ اٰتَيْتُكُمْ مِّنْ كِتٰبٍ وَّحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَاۤءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهٖ وَلَتَنْصُرُنَّهٗ ۗ قَالَ ءَاَقْرَرْتُمْ وَاَخَذْتُمْ عَلٰى ذٰلِكُمْ اِصْرِيْ ۗ قَالُوْٓا اَقْرَرْنَا ۗ قَالَ فَاشْهَدُوْا وَاَنَا۠ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż akhażallāhu mīṡāqan-nabiyyīna lamā ātaitukum min kitābiw wa ḥikmatin ṡumma jā'akum rasūlum muṣaddiqul limā ma‘akum latu'minunna bihī wa latanṣurunnah(ū), qāla a'aqrartum wa akhażtum ‘alā żālikum iṣrī, qālū aqrarnā, qāla fasyhadū wa ana ma‘akum minasy-syāhidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, LO, God accepted, through the prophets, this solemn pledge [from the followers of earlier revelation]: "If, after all the revelation and the wisdom which I have vouchsafed unto you, there comes to you an apostle confirming the truth already in your possession, you must believe in him and succour him. Do you" - said He - "acknowledge and accept My bond on this condition?" They answered: "We do acknowledge it." Said He: "Then bear witness [thereto], and I shall be your witness.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنْ تَوَلّٰى بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faman tawallā ba‘da żālika fa ulā'ika humul-fāsiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, henceforth, all who turn away [from this pledge] - it is they, they who are truly iniquitous!"

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَغَيْرَ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ يَبْغُوْنَ وَلَهٗ ٓ اَسْلَمَ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَّكَرْهًا وَّاِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afagaira dīnillāhi yabgūna wa lahū aslama man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭau‘aw wa ilaihi yurja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Do they seek, perchance, a faith other than in God, although it is unto Him that whatever is in the heavens and on earth surrenders itself, willingly or unwillingly, since unto Him all must return?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلٰٓى اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ وَالْاَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ اُوْتِيَ مُوْسٰى وَعِيْسٰى وَالنَّبِيُّوْنَ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْۖ  لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْۖ وَنَحْنُ لَهٗ مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul āmannā billāhi wa mā unzila ‘alainā wa mā unzila ‘alā ibrāhīma wa ismā‘īla wa isḥāqa wa ya‘qūba wal-asbāṭi wa mā ūtiya mūsā wa ‘īsā wan-nabiyyūna mir rabbihim, lā nufarriqu baina aḥadim minhum, wa naḥnu lahū muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "We believe in God, and in that which has been bestowed from on high upon us, and that which has been bestowed upon Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and their descendants, and that which has been vouchsafed by their Sustainer unto Moses and Jesus and all the [other] prophets: we make no distinction between any of them. And unto Him do we surrender ourselves."

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ يَّبْتَغِ غَيْرَ الْاِسْلَامِ دِيْنًا فَلَنْ يُّقْبَلَ مِنْهُۚ وَهُوَ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa may yabtagi gairal-islāmi dīnan  falay yuqbala minh(u), wa huwa fil-ākhirati minal khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, if one goes in search of a religion other than self-surrender unto God, it will never be accepted from him, and in the life to come he shall be among the lost.

ayahs.textArabic: كَيْفَ يَهْدِى اللّٰهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوْا بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِهِمْ وَشَهِدُوْٓا اَنَّ الرَّسُوْلَ حَقٌّ وَّجَاۤءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Kaifa yahdillāhu qauman kafarū ba‘da īmānihim wa syahidū annar-rasūla ḥaqquw wa jā'ahumul-bayyināt(u), wallāhu lā yahdil-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: How would God bestow His guidance upon people who have resolved to deny the truth after having attained to faith, and having borne witness that this Apostle is true, and [after] all evidence of the truth has come unto them? For, God does not guide such evildoing folk.

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ جَزَاۤؤُهُمْ اَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ اللّٰهِ وَالْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ika jazā'uhum anna ‘alaihim la‘natallāhi wal-malā'ikati wan-nāsi ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Their requital shall be rejection by God, and by the angels, and by all [righteous] men.

ayahs.textArabic: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۚ لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Khālidīna fihā, lā yukhaffafu ‘anhumul-‘ażābu wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this state shall they abide; [and] neither will their suffering be lightened, nor will they be granted respite.

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ تَابُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُوْاۗ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Illal-lażīna tābū mim ba‘di żālika wa aṣlaḥū, fa'innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But excepted shall be they that afterwards repent and put themselves to rights: for, behold, God is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِهِمْ ثُمَّ ازْدَادُوْا كُفْرًا لَّنْ تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ ۚ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الضَّاۤلُّوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna kafarū ba‘da īmānihim ṡummazdādū kufral lan tuqbala taubatuhum, wa ulā'ika humuḍ-ḍāllūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, as for those who are bent on denying the truth after having attained to faith, and then grow [ever more stubborn] in their refusal to acknowledge the truth, their repentance [of other sins] shall not be accepted: for it is they who have truly gone astray.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَمَاتُوْا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يُّقْبَلَ مِنْ اَحَدِهِمْ مِّلْءُ الْاَرْضِ ذَهَبًا وَّلَوِ افْتَدٰى بِهٖۗ  اُولٰۤىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ وَّمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ ࣖ   ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna kafarū wa mātū wa hum kuffārun falay yuqbala min aḥadihim mil'ul-arḍi żahabaw wa lawiftadā bih(ī), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun alīmuw wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, as for those who are bent on denying the truth and die as deniers of the truth - not all the gold on earth could ever be their ransom. It is they for whom grievous suffering is in store; and they shall have none to succour them.

ayahs.textArabic: لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ ۗوَمَا تُنْفِقُوْا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِهٖ عَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Lan tanālul-birra ḥattā tunfiqū mimmā tuḥibbūn(a), wa mā tunfiqū min syai'in fa innallāha bihī ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But as for you, O believers,] never shall you attain to true piety unless you spend on others out of what you cherish yourselves; and whatever you spend - verily, God has full knowledge thereof.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ كُلُّ الطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ اِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلُ عَلٰى نَفْسِهٖ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ تُنَزَّلَ التَّوْرٰىةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوْا بِالتَّوْرٰىةِ فَاتْلُوْهَآ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Kulluṭ-ṭa‘āmi kāna ḥillal libanī isrā'īla illā mā ḥarrama isrā'īlu ‘alā nafsihī min qabli an tunazzalat-taurāh(tu), qul fa'tū bit-taurāti fatlūhā in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: ALL FOOD was lawful unto the children of Israel, save what Israel had made unlawful unto itself [by its sinning] before the Torah was bestowed from on high. Say: "Come forward, then, with the Torah and recite it, if what you say is true!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa maniftarā ‘alallāhil-każiba mim ba‘di żālika fa ulā'ika humuẓ-ẓālimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And all who henceforth invent lies about God - it is they, they who are evildoers!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ صَدَقَ اللّٰهُ ۗ فَاتَّبِعُوْا مِلَّةَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًاۗ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ṣadaqallāh(u), fattabi‘ū millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā(n), wa mā kāna minal-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "God has spoken the truth: follow, then, the creed of Abraham, who turned away from all that is false, and was not of those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God."

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُّضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِيْ بِبَكَّةَ مُبٰرَكًا وَّهُدًى لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna awwala baitiw wuḍi‘a lin-nāsi lal-lażī bibakkata mubārakaw wa hudal lil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, the first Temple ever set up for mankind was indeed the one at Bakkah: rich in blessing, and a [source of] guidance unto all the worlds,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْهِ اٰيٰتٌۢ بَيِّنٰتٌ مَّقَامُ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ەۚ وَمَنْ دَخَلَهٗ كَانَ اٰمِنًا ۗ وَلِلّٰهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا ۗ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fīhi āyātum bayyinātum maqāmu ibrāhīm(a), wa man dakhalahū kāna āminā(n), wa lillāhi ‘alan-nāsi ḥijjul-baiti manistaṭā‘a ilaihi sabīlā(n), wa man kafara fa innallāha ganiyyun ‘anil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: full of clear messages. [It is] the place whereon Abraham once stood; and whoever enters it finds inner peace. Hence, pilgrimage unto the Temple is a duty owed to God by all people who are able to undertake it. And as for those who deny the truth - verily, God does not stand in need of anything in all the worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَاللّٰهُ شَهِيْدٌ عَلٰى مَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna bi'āyātillāh(i), wallāhu syahīdun ‘alā mā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: "O followers of earlier revelation! Why do you refuse to acknowledge the truth of God's messages, when God is witness to all that you do?"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يٰٓاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ تَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا وَّاَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاۤءُ ۗ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima taṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi man āmana tabgūnahā ‘iwajaw wa antum syuhadā'(u), wa mallāhu bigāfilin ‘ammā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "O followers of earlier revelation! Why do you [endeavour to] bar those who have come to believe [in this divine writ] from the path of God by trying to make it appear crooked, when you yourselves bear witness [to its being straight]? For, God is not unaware of what you do."

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنْ تُطِيْعُوْا فَرِيْقًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ يَرُدُّوْكُمْ بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِكُمْ كٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū in tuṭī‘ū farīqam minal-lażīna ūtul-kitāba yaruddūkum ba‘da īmānikum kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O you who have attained to faith! If you pay heed to some of those to whom revelation was vouchsafed aforetime, they might cause you to renounce the truth after you have come to believe [in it].

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُوْنَ وَاَنْتُمْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ وَفِيْكُمْ رَسُوْلُهٗ ۗ وَمَنْ يَّعْتَصِمْ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدْ هُدِيَ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kaifa takfurūna wa antum tutlā ‘alaikum āyātullāhi wa fīkum rasūluh(ū), wa may ya‘taṣim billāhi faqad hudiya ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And how could you deny the truth when it is unto you that God's messages are being conveyed, and it is in your midst that His Apostle lives? But he who holds fast unto God has already been guided onto a straight way.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ تُقٰىتِهٖ وَلَا تَمُوْتُنَّ اِلَّا وَاَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanuttaqullāha ḥaqqa tuqātihī wa lā tamūtunna illā wa antum muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O you who have attained to faith! Be conscious of God with all the consciousness that is due to Him, and do not allow death to overtake you ere you have surrendered yourselves unto Him.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاعْتَصِمُوْا بِحَبْلِ اللّٰهِ جَمِيْعًا وَّلَا تَفَرَّقُوْا ۖوَاذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ كُنْتُمْ اَعْدَاۤءً فَاَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوْبِكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُمْ بِنِعْمَتِهٖٓ اِخْوَانًاۚ وَكُنْتُمْ عَلٰى شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ فَاَنْقَذَكُمْ مِّنْهَا ۗ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa‘taṣimū biḥablillāhi jamī‘aw wa lā tafarraqū, ważkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum iż kuntum a‘dā'an fa allafa baina qulūbikum fa aṣbaḥtum bi ni‘matihī ikhwānā(n), wa kuntum ‘alā syafā ḥufratim minan-nāri fa anqażakum minhā, każālika yubayyinullāhu lakum āyātihī la‘allakum tahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And hold fast, all together, unto the bond with God, and do not draw apart from one another. And remember the blessings which God has bestowed upon you: how, when you were enemies, He brought your hearts together, so that through His blessing you became brethren; and [how, when] you were on the brink of a fiery abyss. He saved you from it. In this way God makes clear His messages unto you, so that you might find guidance,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلْتَكُنْ مِّنْكُمْ اُمَّةٌ يَّدْعُوْنَ اِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ۗ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Waltakum minkum ummatuy yad‘ūna ilal-khairi wa ya'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa yanhauna ‘anil-munkar(i), wa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that there might grow out of you a community [of people] who invite unto all that is good, and enjoin the doing of what is right and forbid the doing of what is wrong: and it is they, they who shall attain to a happy state!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ تَفَرَّقُوْا وَاخْتَلَفُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ ۗ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā takūnū kal-lażīna tafarraqū wakhtalafū mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-bayyināt(u), wa ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And be not like those who have drawn apart from one another and have taken to conflicting views after all evidence of the truth has come unto them: for these it is for whom tremendous suffering is in store

ayahs.textArabic: يَّوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوْهٌ وَّتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوْهٌ ۚ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوْهُهُمْۗ  اَ كَفَرْتُمْ بَعْدَ اِيْمَانِكُمْ فَذُوْقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tabyaḍḍu wujūhuw wa taswaddu wujūh(un), fa ammal-lażīnaswaddat wujūhuhum, akafartum ba‘da īmānikum fa żūqul-‘ażāba bimā kuntum takfurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: on the Day [of Judgment] when some faces will shine [with happiness] and some faces will be dark [with grief]. And as for those with faces darkened, [they shall be told:] "Did you deny the truth after having attained to faith? Taste, then, this suffering for having denied the truth!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ ابْيَضَّتْ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فَفِيْ رَحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۗ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal lażīnabyaḍḍat wujūhuhum fafī raḥmatillāh(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But as for those with faces shining, they shall be within God's grace, therein to abide.

ayahs.textArabic: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتْلُوْهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيْدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ‘alaika bil-ḥaqq(i), wa mallāhu yurīdu ẓulmal lil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: These are God's messages: We convey them unto thee, setting forth the truth, since God wills no wrong to His creation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۗوَاِلَى اللّٰهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُوْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wa ilallāhi turja‘ul-umūr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And unto God belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; and all things go back to God [as their source].

ayahs.textArabic: كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ اُمَّةٍ اُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ ۗ وَلَوْ اٰمَنَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۗ مِنْهُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَاَكْثَرُهُمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat lin-nāsi ta'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa tanhauna ‘anil-munkari wa tu'minūna billāh(i), wa lau āmana ahlul-kitābi lakāna khairal lahum, minhumul-mu'minūna wa akṡaruhumul-fāsiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: YOU ARE indeed the best community that has ever been brought forth for [the good of] mankind: you enjoin the doing of what is right and forbid the doing of what is wrong, and you believe in God. Now if the followers of earlier revelation had attained to [this kind of] faith, it would have been for their own good; [but only few] among them are believers, while most of them are iniquitous:

ayahs.textArabic: لَنْ يَّضُرُّوْكُمْ اِلَّآ اَذًىۗ  وَاِنْ يُّقَاتِلُوْكُمْ يُوَلُّوْكُمُ الْاَدْبَارَۗ  ثُمَّ لَا يُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lay yaḍurrūkum illā ażā(n), wa iy yuqātilūkum yuwallūkumul-adbār(a), ṡumma lā yunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [but] these can never inflict more than a passing hurt on you; and if they fight against you, they will turn their backs upon you [in flight], and will not be succoured.

ayahs.textArabic: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ اَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوْٓا اِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَحَبْلٍ مِّنَ النَّاسِ وَبَاۤءُوْ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَسْكَنَةُ ۗ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا يَكْفُرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقْتُلُوْنَ الْاَنْبِۢيَاۤءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۗ  ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوْا وَّكَانُوْا يَعْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḍuribat ‘alaihimuż-żillatu aina mā ṡuqifū illā biḥablim minallāhi wa ḥablim minan-nāsi wa bā'ū bigaḍabim minallāhi wa ḍuribat ‘alaihimul-maskanah(tu), żālika bi'annahum kānū yakfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa yaqtulūnal-ambiyā'a bigairi ḥaqq(in), żālika bimā ‘aṣaw wa kānū ya‘tadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Overshadowed by ignominy are they wherever they may be, save [when they bind themselves again] in a bond with God and a bond with men; for they have earned the burden of God's condemnation, and are overshadowed by humiliation: all this [has befallen them] because they persisted in denying the truth of God's messages and in slaying the prophets against all right: all this, because they rebelled [against God], and persisted in transgressing the bounds of what is right.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ لَيْسُوْا سَوَاۤءً ۗ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اُمَّةٌ قَاۤىِٕمَةٌ يَّتْلُوْنَ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اٰنَاۤءَ الَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Laisū sawā'ā(n), min ahlil-kitābi ummatun qā'imatuy yatlūna āyātillāhi ānā'al-laili wa hum yasjudūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] they are not all alike: among the followers of earlier revelation there are upright people, who recite God's messages throughout the night, and prostrate themselves [before Him].

ayahs.textArabic: يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُوْنَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُسَارِعُوْنَ فِى الْخَيْرٰتِۗ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yu'minūna billāhi wal-yaumil-ākhiri wa ya'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa yanhauna ‘anil-munkari wa yusāri‘ūna fil-khairāt(i), wa ulā'ika minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They believe in God and the Last Day, and enjoin the doing of what is right and forbid the doing of what is wrong, and vie with one another in doing good works: and these are among the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوْا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ يُّكْفَرُوْهُ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ ۢبِالْمُتَّقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā yaf‘alūna min khairin falay yukfarūh(u), wallāhu ‘alīmum bil-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And whatever good they do, they shall never be denied the reward thereof: for, God has full knowledge of those who are conscious of Him.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ اَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَآ اَوْلَادُهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ ۚ هُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna kafarū lan tugniya ‘anhum amwāluhum wa lā aulāduhum minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa ulā'ika aṣḥābun-nār(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] behold, as for those who are bent on denying the truth - neither their worldly possessions nor their children will in the least avail them against God: and it is they who are destined for the fire, therein to abide.

ayahs.textArabic: مَثَلُ مَا يُنْفِقُوْنَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيْحٍ فِيْهَا صِرٌّ اَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَاَهْلَكَتْهُ ۗ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰكِنْ اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Maṡalu mā yunfiqūna fī hāżihil-ḥayātid-dun-yā kamaṡali rīḥin fihā ṣirrun aṣābat ḥarṡa qaumin ẓalamū anfusahum fa ahlakath(u), wa mā ẓalamahumullāhu wa lākin anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: The parable of what they spend on the life of this world is that of an icy wind which smites the tilth of people who have sinned against themselves, and destroys it: for, it is not God who does them wrong, but it is they who are wronging themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّخِذُوْا بِطَانَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُوْنَكُمْ خَبَالًاۗ وَدُّوْا مَا عَنِتُّمْۚ قَدْ بَدَتِ الْبَغْضَاۤءُ مِنْ اَفْوَاهِهِمْۖ وَمَا تُخْفِيْ صُدُوْرُهُمْ اَكْبَرُ ۗ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْاٰيٰتِ  اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā tattakhiżū biṭānatam min dūnikum lā ya'lūnakum khabālā(n), waddū mā ‘anittum, qad badatil-bagḍā'u min afwāhihim, wa mā tukhfī ṣudūruhum akbar(u), qad bayyannā lakumul-āyāti in kuntum ta‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Do not take for your bosom-friends people who are not of your kind. They spare no effort to corrupt you; they would love to see you in distress. Vehement hatred has already come into the open from out of their mouths, but what their hearts conceal is yet worse. We have indeed made the signs [thereof] clear unto you, if you would but use your reason.

ayahs.textArabic: هٰٓاَنْتُمْ اُولَاۤءِ تُحِبُّوْنَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّوْنَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْكِتٰبِ كُلِّهٖۚ وَاِذَا لَقُوْكُمْ قَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّاۖ وَاِذَا خَلَوْا عَضُّوْا عَلَيْكُمُ الْاَنَامِلَ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۗ قُلْ مُوْتُوْا بِغَيْظِكُمْ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ ۢبِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Hā antum ulā'i tuḥibbūnahum wa lā yuḥibbūnakum wa tu'minūna bil-kitābi kullih(ī), wa iżā laqūkum qālū āmannā, wa iżā khalau ‘aḍḍū ‘alaikumul-anāmila  minal-gaiẓ(i), qul mūtū bigaiẓikum, innallāha ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! It is you who [are prepared to] love them, but they will not love you, although you believe in all of the revelation. And when they meet you, they assert, "We believe [as you believe]"; but when they find themselves alone, they gnaw their fingers in rage against you. Say: "Perish in your rage! Behold, God has full knowledge of what is in the hearts [of men]!"

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْۖ وَاِنْ تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّفْرَحُوْا بِهَا ۗ وَاِنْ تَصْبِرُوْا وَتَتَّقُوْا لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِيْطٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: In tamsaskum ḥasanatun tasu'hum, wa in tuṣibkum sayyi'atuy yafraḥū bihā, wa in taṣbirū wa tattaqū lā yaḍurrukum kaiduhum syai'ā(n), innallāha bimā ya‘malūna muḥīṭ(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: If good fortune comes to you, it grieves them; and if evil befalls you, they rejoice in it. But if you are patient in adversity and conscious of God, their guile cannot harm you at all: for, verily, God encompasses [with His might] all that they do.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ اَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż gadauka min ahlika tubawwi'ul-mu'minīna maqā‘ida lil-qitāl(i), wallāhu samī‘un ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [remember, O Prophet, the day] when thou didst set out from thy home at early morn to place the believers in battle array. And God was all-hearing, all-knowing

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ هَمَّتْ طَّۤاىِٕفَتٰنِ مِنْكُمْ اَنْ تَفْشَلَاۙ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا ۗ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż hammat-ṭā'ifatāni minkum an tafsyalā, wallāhu waliyyuhumā, wa ‘alallāhi falyatawakkalil-mu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when two groups from among you were about to lose heart, although God was near unto them and it is in God that the believers must place their trust:

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَّاَنْتُمْ اَذِلَّةٌ  ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad naṣarakumullāhu bibadriw wa antum ażillah(tun), fattaqullāha la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, indeed, God did succour you at Badr, when you were utterly weak. Remain, then, conscious of God, so that you might have cause to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ تَقُوْلُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَلَنْ يَّكْفِيَكُمْ اَنْ يُّمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِثَلٰثَةِ اٰلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ مُنْزَلِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż taqūlu lil-mu'minīna alay yakfiyakum ay yumiddakum rabbukum biṡalāṡati ālāfim minal-malā'ikati munzalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And remember] when thou didst say unto the believers: "Is it not enough for you [to know] that your Sustainer will aid you with three thousand angels sent down [from on high]?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلٰٓى ۙاِنْ تَصْبِرُوْا وَتَتَّقُوْا وَيَأْتُوْكُمْ مِّنْ فَوْرِهِمْ هٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِخَمْسَةِ اٰلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ مُسَوِّمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Balā, in taṣbirū wa tattaqū wa ya'tūkum min faurihim hāżā yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati ālāfim minal-malā'ikati musawwimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but if you are patient in adversity and conscious of Him, and the enemy should fall upon you of a sudden, your Sustainer will aid you with five thousand angels swooping down!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بُشْرٰى لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَىِٕنَّ قُلُوْبُكُمْ بِهٖ ۗ وَمَا النَّصْرُ اِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَكِيْمِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ja‘alahullāhu illā busyrā lakum wa litaṭma'inna qulūbukum bih(ī), wa man-naṣru illā min ‘indillāhil-‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God ordained this [to be said by His Apostle] only as a glad tiding for you, and that your hearts should thereby be set at rest - since no succour can come from any save God, the Almighty, the Truly Wise -

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنْقَلِبُوْا خَاۤىِٕبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyaqṭa‘a ṭarafam minal-lażīna kafarū au yakbitahum fa yanqalibū khā'ibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] that [through you] He might destroy some of those who were bent on denying the truth, and so abase the others that they would withdraw in utter hopelessness.

ayahs.textArabic: لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ شَيْءٌ اَوْ يَتُوْبَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Laisa laka minal-amri syai'un au yatūba ‘alaihim au yu‘ażżibahum fa innahum ẓālimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] it is in no wise for thee [O Prophet] to decide whether He shall accept their repentance or chastise them - for, behold, they are but wrongdoers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِۗ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ ۗ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), yagfiru limay yasyā'u wa yu‘ażżibu may yasyā'(u), wallāhu gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas unto God belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth: He forgives whom He wills, and He chastises whom He wills; and God is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَأْكُلُوا الرِّبٰوٓا اَضْعَافًا مُّضٰعَفَةً ۖوَّاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā ta'kulur-ribā aḍ‘āfam muḍā‘afah(tan), wattaqullāha la‘allakum tufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Do not gorge yourselves on usury, doubling and re-doubling it - but remain conscious of God, so that you might attain to a happy state;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِيْٓ اُعِدَّتْ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattaqun-nāral latī u‘iddat lil-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and beware of the fire which awaits those who deny the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَطِيْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوْلَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa aṭī‘ullāha war-rasūla la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And pay heed unto God and the Apostle, so that you might be graced with mercy.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَسَارِعُوْٓا اِلٰى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالْاَرْضُۙ  اُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sāri‘ū ilā magfiratim mir rabbikum wa jannatin ‘arḍuhas-samāwātu wal-arḍ(u), u‘iddat lil-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And vie with one another to attain to your Sustainer's forgiveness and to a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, which has been readied for the God-conscious

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ فِى السَّرَّۤاءِ وَالضَّرَّۤاءِ وَالْكٰظِمِيْنَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِيْنَ عَنِ النَّاسِۗ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-lażīna yunfiqūna fis-sarrā'i waḍ-ḍarrā'i wal-kāẓimīnal gaiẓa wal-‘āfīna ‘anin-nās(i), wallāhu yuḥibbul-muḥsinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who spend [in His way] in time of plenty and in time of hardship, and hold in check their anger, and pardon their fellow-men because God loves the doers of good;

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا فَعَلُوْا فَاحِشَةً اَوْ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِهِمْۗ وَمَنْ يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۗ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوْا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوْا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna iżā fa‘alū fāḥisyatan au ẓalamū anfusahum żakarullāha fastagfarū liżunūbihim, wa may yagfiruż-żunūba illallāh(u), wa lam yuṣirrū ‘alā mā fa‘alū wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and who, when they have committed a shameful deed or have [otherwise] sinned against themselves, remember God and pray that their sins be forgiven - for who but God could forgive sins? - and do not knowingly persist in doing whatever [wrong] they may have done.

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ جَزَاۤؤُهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۗ وَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ika jazā'uhum magfiratum mir rabbihim wa jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā, wa ni‘ma ajrul-‘āmilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: These it is who shall have as their reward forgiveness from their Sustainer, and gardens through which running waters flow, therein to abide: and how excellent a reward for those who labour!

ayahs.textArabic: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌۙ فَسِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad khalat min qablikum sunan(un), fa sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mukażżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [MANY] WAYS of life have passed away before your time. Go, then, about the earth and behold what happened in the end to those who gave the lie to the truth:

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَّمَوْعِظَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā bayānul lin-nāsi wa hudaw wa mau‘iẓatul lil-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: this [should be] a clear lesson unto all men, and a guidance and an admonition unto the God-conscious.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوْا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْا وَاَنْتُمُ الْاَعْلَوْنَ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū wa antumul-a‘launa in kuntum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Be not, then, faint of heart, and grieve not: for you are bound to rise high if you are [truly] believers.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ يَّمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهٗ ۗوَتِلْكَ الْاَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ النَّاسِۚ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَاۤءَ ۗوَاللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Iy yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massal-qauma qarḥum miṡluh(ū), wa tilkal-ayyāmu nudāwiluhā binan-nās(i), wa liya‘lamallāhul-lażīna āmanū wa yattakhiża minkum syuhadā'(u),  wallāhu lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: If misfortune touches you, [know that] similar misfortune has touched [other] people as well; for it is by turns that We apportion unto men such days [of fortune and misfortune]: and [this] to the end that God might mark out those who have attained to faith, and choose from among you such as [with their lives] bear witness to the truth - since God does not love evildoers -

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَيَمْحَقَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa liyumaḥḥiṣallāhul-lażīna āmanū wa yamḥaqal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that God might render pure of all dross those who have attained to faith, and bring to nought those who deny the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ اَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ جَاهَدُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصّٰبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ḥasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata wa lammā ya‘lamillāhul-lażīna jāhadū minkum wa ya‘lamaṣ-ṣābirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Do you think that you could enter paradise unless God takes cognizance of your having striven hard [in His cause], and takes cognizance of your having been patient in adversity?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ تَلْقَوْهُۖ فَقَدْ رَاَيْتُمُوْهُ وَاَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad kuntum tamannaunal-mauta min qabli an talqauh(u), faqad ra'aitumūhu wa antum tanẓurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, indeed, you did long for death [in God’s cause] before you came face to face with it; and now you have seen it with your own eyes!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ اِلَّا رَسُوْلٌۚ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ ۗ اَفَا۟ىِٕنْ مَّاتَ اَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلٰٓى اَعْقَابِكُمْ ۗ وَمَنْ يَّنْقَلِبْ عَلٰى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَّضُرَّ اللّٰهَ شَيْـًٔا  ۗوَسَيَجْزِى اللّٰهُ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā muḥammadun illā rasūl(un), qad khalat min qablihir-rusul(u), afa'im māta au qutilanqalabtum ‘alā a‘qābikum, wa may yanqalib ‘alā ‘aqibaihi falay yaḍurrallāha syai'ā(n), wa sayajzillāhusy-syākirīn(a).
